name: ftc-programming-atlas
description: FTC Programming Atlas web and native mobile application

scripts.mobile:sync: npm run mobile:build && npx cap sync
scripts.android:init: npm run mobile:build && npx cap add android && npm run android:assets
scripts.android:add: npm run mobile:build && npx cap add android
scripts.android:open: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:run: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap run android
scripts.android:apk: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.ios:init: npm run mobile:build && npx cap add ios && npm run ios:assets
scripts.ios:add: npm run mobile:build && npx cap add ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap open ios
